data.name: Armed Resupply Pods
data.description: The Armed Resupply Pods are a Booster in Helldivers 2. When equipped, all Resupply Pods come mounted with an automated custom AR-23P Liberator Penetrator lasting until ran out of bullets or the pod itself getting demolished.
data.effect: Mounts a modified AR-23 Liberator to all resupply pods, allowing them to double as automatic turrets.
